description: This file implements rendering functions for 2D ellipses, including stroke and fill rendering, using OpenGL. It contains functions to draw rings and filled ellipses with specified parameters.

methods.name: void lu5_render_ring(lua_Number x,lua_Number y,lua_Number inner_radius_w,lua_Number inner_radius_h,lua_Number strokeWeight,lu5_color color,lua_Integer segments)
methods.description: Renders a ring (outline) of an ellipse with specified inner radii and stroke weight using OpenGL triangle strip.

methods.name: void lu5_render_ellipse_fill(lua_Number x,lua_Number y,lua_Number w,lua_Number h,lu5_color color,lua_Integer segments)
methods.description: Fills an ellipse with specified dimensions and color using OpenGL triangle fan.

methods.name: void lu5_render_ellipse(lua_Number x,lua_Number y,lua_Number w,lua_Number h,lua_Number strokeWeight,lu5_color fill,lu5_color stroke,lua_Integer segments)
methods.description: Renders an ellipse with optional stroke and fill colors, delegating to ring and fill functions.
